mission.name: XRP intelligence and prediction-engine mastery
mission.foundation: Barrot V3 execution, orchestration, safety and verification

source_capture_policy.admission_rule: Keep every observation research-only until the original issuer files and any upstream aggregator payloads are captured byte-for-byte, SHA-256 receipts are independently checked, publication/effective/first-seen times are separated, and same-fund same-date values reconcile.

limitations: Flows are calculated as day-over-day changes in issuer-reported holdings, not read from authorized-participant cash creation/redemption records.
The publisher explicitly says non-creation/redemption changes such as BITW index rebalancing and fee accruals paid in XRP can appear as flow.
The seven-ticker universe includes XRPR, whose issuer file reports direct holdings while some exposure is held through other ETPs; it is not a clean direct-spot-only measure.
GXRP holdings remain in holdings totals, but its daily flow is withheld because of a historical issuer-page capture gap.
Flow-excluded funds contribute zero to the displayed aggregate; zero is not a verified issuer flow for an excluded fund.
Daily flow universe contains XRP/Bitwise, XRPZ/Franklin Templeton, XRPC/Canary Capital and TOXR/21Shares.
GXRP is not collected daily because of an automated bot challenge; displayed holdings are a stale quarter-end SEC figure and are excluded from daily flow totals.
XRPR is excluded because its direct-coin file does not represent its complete indirect ETP exposure.
The publisher defines flow as holdings change and notes that staking rewards, fee sales and cash payouts can affect the change.
November 4 remains partial at three of four funds; Franklin Templeton XRPZ had not published at the page's update time.
The dashboard displays zero net flow for November 4 across five of five funds and zero for November 3.
It does not publish the XRP funds' holdings or AUM on this dashboard; its flow series is the only displayed ETF measurement.
Alpha Finance's methodology page identifies Coinglass as the ETF-dashboard feed, so this is not an independent issuer-level cash-flow measurement.
The rendered value is recorded as displayed; no raw upstream Coinglass response or issuer file was captured.
The dashboard displays zero for November 4 and November 3, and approximately negative 530,000 USD for November 2, concentrated in XRPC.
The page says its source is the figures XRP funds report each trading day but does not expose the underlying issuer files or a reproducible per-fund calculation in this capture.
A blank or incomplete day is not equivalent to a zero; the rendered table marks some older incomplete dates as not yet reported.
No raw issuer or aggregator bytes were preserved.

fund_universe_differences: XRP Insights includes seven tickers, including BITW and XRPR, and carries GXRP holdings while withholding its daily flow.
CryptoKeyhole includes four daily issuer files and excludes GXRP and XRPR from daily flow totals.
Alpha Finance and Maketo each display five tickers: XRP, XRPZ, XRPC, GXRP and TOXR; neither displayed a complete holdings/AUM crosswalk in this capture.
cross_provider_reconciliation.source_independence: These are four publisher interfaces, not four independent measurements of investor cash. XRP Insights and CryptoKeyhole calculate from issuer holdings files; Alpha Finance identifies Coinglass as its ETF-dashboard feed; Maketo references fund-reported figures but its raw pipeline is not exposed. The issuer files and authorized-participant settlement records remain the primary evidence needed.
cross_provider_reconciliation.comparison_rule: Do not average the XRP Insights three-day XRP holdings delta, CryptoKeyhole's partial per-fund holdings changes, Alpha Finance's displayed USD flow, and Maketo's displayed USD flow. The units, dates, fund universes, completeness and upstream data paths differ.

counter_hypotheses.hypothesis: Part of the aggregate difference is explained by BITW index exposure, XRPR indirect ETP exposure and GXRP's withheld daily flow rather than different investor decisions.
disconfirming_evidence_to_seek: Same-date holdings and shares outstanding for every common fund
Explicit look-through XRP exposure for XRPR

counter_hypotheses.hypothesis: Issuer files published after the US close and providers' different effective-date conventions shift some holdings changes between trading dates.
disconfirming_evidence_to_seek: Original issuer file bytes and publication timestamps
Each file's effective holdings date and first-seen time
A same-fund, same-date comparison after all issuers have settled

counter_hypotheses.hypothesis: A holdings decrease can include fee sales, cash payouts, staking rewards, index rebalancing or other position adjustments, not only investor redemptions.
disconfirming_evidence_to_seek: Authorized-participant cash and coin creation/redemption records
Custodian XRP movements reconciled to shares outstanding and XRP-per-share

counter_hypotheses.hypothesis: Displayed zero values may be rounded, delayed or sourced from an upstream feed with a different refresh schedule rather than exact zero XRP movement.
disconfirming_evidence_to_seek: Raw Alpha/Coinglass and Maketo input payloads
Exact unrounded per-fund XRP and USD flow values

reasons: The four dashboards do not share one common fund universe or one common flow unit.
The XRP Insights three-day aggregate is a holdings delta, not direct AP cash-flow evidence.
CryptoKeyhole's November 4 observation is partial at three of four funds.
Alpha Finance and Maketo show zero for November 4 while CryptoKeyhole shows a small negative XRPC change; the common-fund discrepancy is unresolved.
No byte-complete issuer files, SHA-256 receipts or independent publication-time anchors were captured.
next_data_requirements: Capture the original daily holdings file for each issuer with exact bytes and SHA-256.
Store effective trading date, issuer publication time, retrieval time and first-seen time separately.
Reconcile shares outstanding, XRP-per-share, NAV, net assets and custodian balances per fund.
Separate direct spot products, multi-asset index sleeves, 1940 Act structures and indirect ETP exposure.
Obtain authorized-participant cash/coin creation-redemption records before calling holdings changes institutional cash flows.
